metadata.evidence_boundary: Public hiring and open-source activity indicate observable technical investment. They do not prove budget, purchase intent, qualification, pipeline, bookings, or customer status.

briefing.finding: 1,866 of 5,886 public openings met the documented AI/ML or infrastructure relevance rule.
briefing.action: Use the signal as a research queue; do not relabel postings as qualified pipeline.

briefing.finding: Databricks leads the eligible panel at a 64.5 priority score, supported by multiple independent public sources.
briefing.action: Review the source evidence and workload fit before account outreach.

briefing.finding: The four-rep planning scenario has a 24.8% max-to-min spread in weighted potential.
briefing.action: Treat the assignment as a capacity scenario and adjust constraints with sales leadership.

briefing.finding: All 27 automated checks passed; 3 company identity mappings remain in the review queue.
briefing.action: Resolve medium-confidence mappings before activating account-level recommendations.

definitions.gtm_priority_score: Panel-relative composite: 45% hiring signal, 30% public open-source signal, and 25% public model signal. It ranks research attention, not purchase probability.
definitions.relevant_open_job: A published opening with an explicit AI/ML title or a technical title paired with a concrete GPU, distributed-compute, model-serving, or ML-platform term.
definitions.strategic_account: Planning-eligible account with a priority score of at least 50 and evidence from at least two sources.
definitions.weighted_potential: Planning unit equal to 25 plus the panel-relative priority score; used only to compare scenario territory load.
